footnotes: Caco-2: Caucasian colon adenocarcinoma permeability (Log Papp in 10−6 cm/s). IA: intestinal absorption (% absorbed). SP: skin permeability (logKp). VDss: steady-state volume of distribution (Log L/kg). BBB: blood–brain barrier permeability (log BB). CNS: central nervous system (Log PS). CYP2D6: Cytochrome P450 2D6 inhibitor; CYP3A4: Cytochrome P450 3A4 inhibitor. TC: total clearance (Log mL/min/kg). LD50: lethal dose, 50% (mol/Kg). LOAEL: lowest observed adverse effect level (Log mg/kg bw/day). KA: kojic acid.
